title: Peptide Therapy in Brisbane: What You Need to Know
html:
What Are Peptides?

Peptides are short chains of amino acids – the building blocks of proteins – that act as biological signalling molecules in the body. Unlike full proteins, peptides are small enough to cross cell membranes and interact directly with receptors, triggering specific physiological responses such as tissue repair, hormone release, immune modulation, and cellular regeneration.

The human body naturally produces hundreds of different peptides, each with distinct functions. As we age, the production of many key peptides declines, contributing to slower recovery, reduced muscle mass, increased body fat, impaired sleep, and accelerated ageing. Peptide therapy aims to restore these signalling pathways using pharmaceutical-grade synthetic peptides that closely mimic the body's own molecules.

At Australian Longevity Clinic in Brisbane, all peptide programs are prescribed and supervised by our registered medical practitioners. Treatment plans are individualised based on a thorough health assessment, blood work, and your specific wellness goals.

How Is Peptide Therapy Administered?

Peptides can be administered in several ways depending on the specific compound and treatment goal:

  • Subcutaneous injection – the most common method, involving a small self-administered injection under the skin, similar to insulin injections
  • Intramuscular injection – delivered into muscle tissue for certain compounds
  • Nasal spray – used for peptides such as Selank, which are absorbed through the nasal mucosa
  • Topical cream – used for compounds such as GHK-Cu, applied directly to the skin

Our medical team will guide you through the administration technique appropriate for your prescribed peptide protocol, and will provide full training and support materials.

Peptide Programs at Australian Longevity Clinic

BPC-157 – Repair & Healing

Body Protection Compound 157 (BPC-157) is a peptide derived from a protein found in gastric juice that has been the subject of scientific research. It is used as part of doctor-prescribed repair and recovery programs. Suitability is assessed on an individual basis following a thorough medical consultation.

CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin – Growth Hormone Optimisation

This combination peptide stack has been the subject of scientific research in relation to growth hormone secretion. CJC-1295 is a GHRH analogue and Ipamorelin is a selective GH secretagogue. This protocol is individually assessed and prescribed by our registered medical practitioners following a thorough consultation.

Epitalon – Cellular Health & Longevity

Epitalon is a tetrapeptide that has been the subject of scientific research in relation to cellular ageing and telomere biology. It is individually prescribed as part of a doctor-led program following a thorough medical assessment.

Thymosin Alpha-1 – Immune Modulation

Thymosin Alpha-1 is a naturally occurring peptide produced by the thymus gland that has been the subject of scientific research in relation to immune function. At Australian Longevity Clinic, Thymosin Alpha-1 is used as part of individually prescribed immune and gut health programs. Suitability is assessed on an individual basis following a thorough medical consultation.

TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4) – Recovery & Inflammation

TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4) is a peptide that has been the subject of scientific research in relation to tissue repair and inflammation. It is individually prescribed as part of a doctor-led program following a thorough medical assessment.

Selank – Cognitive Vitality

Selank is a synthetic analogue of the naturally occurring peptide tuftsin that has been the subject of scientific research. It is administered as a nasal spray. Suitability is assessed on an individual basis by our registered medical practitioners following a thorough consultation.

GHK-Cu – Skin Health & Hair Regeneration

GHK-Cu is a naturally occurring copper complex found in human plasma that has been the subject of scientific research in relation to skin health and collagen synthesis. It is available as both a topical cream and injectable formulation at Australian Longevity Clinic, prescribed on an individual basis following a medical consultation.

Wegovy & Mounjaro – Weight Management

For patients with weight management goals, Australian Longevity Clinic offers doctor-prescribed GLP-1 receptor agonist programs using Wegovy (semaglutide) and Mounjaro (tirzepatide). These are prescription medicines that require a thorough medical assessment and individual prescription. Suitability is determined on an individual basis by our registered medical practitioners.

Who Is Peptide Therapy Suitable For?

Peptide therapy may be appropriate for adults seeking support with:

  • Chronic injury recovery and musculoskeletal repair
  • Healthy ageing and cellular longevity
  • Sleep quality and growth hormone support
  • Immune function and gut health
  • Cognitive wellness
  • Skin quality and hair health

A thorough medical assessment is required before any peptide program is prescribed. Peptide therapy is not appropriate for patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding, or for those with certain hormone-sensitive conditions. Our doctors will review your full health history and any relevant blood work before recommending a treatment plan.
